## recv-n8n-error (global error workflow, N8N-6.1)
**Trigger:** n8n's Error Trigger: this is the error workflow (`settings.errorWorkflow`) of the entry workflows recv-wazuh-alert and pb-generic. A library's unhandled error reaches it through its waiting caller (n8n would otherwise report it twice).
**Inputs:** n8n's error item `{execution: {id, error, lastNodeExecuted, mode}, workflow: {id, name}}`.
**Actions taken:** hands the error to lib-error without waiting; lib-error classifies it and parks it.
**Systems changed:** none here.
**Approval:** not applicable.
**Owner:** n8n.
Kept out of lib-error on purpose: a workflow containing an Error Trigger is its own error workflow, so lib-error's deliberate "Stop and Error" would start a second, duplicate park.
A crashed execution (`WorkflowCrashedError`) is recorded here and not parked (N8N-1.4): the alert queue requeues its alert at start-up.
